summary: spectral-core 3.0.7 exfiltrates AWS container IAM credentials at npm install via binding.gyp action
details: The package ships a binding.gyp with gypfile:true but no native C/C++ sources, so node-gyp rebuild runs automatically during npm install and executes an inline `node -e` script defined as a GYP action. That script reads AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI and ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 from the environment, requests IAM credentials and task metadata from the ECS/Fargate link-local metadata endpoint at 169.254.170.2, and POSTs the harvested credentials and metadata to https://webhook.site/d6092bdc-05c0-45da-a280-c343ea6d6156. The only other file is an index.js stub with no functionality matching the package name, and no native sources exist for the GYP target to build. The binding.gyp is used solely as a covert install-time execution hook to steal cloud container role credentials from CI/cloud installers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
